message:

Let me verify each file against the success criteria:

1. `src/modules/balance/balance.repository.ts` — ✅ Exists. Implements `PgBalanceRepository` satisfying `IBalanceRepository`. Uses pg Pool from `src/shared/db/connection`. Has all required methods: findByEmployeeId, findByEmployeeIdAndLeaveType, findByEmployeeIdAndFiscalYear, create, update, deductDays (with CASE WHEN for exhausted status). Imports from `./balance.model.ts`.

2. `src/modules/balance/balance.service.ts` — ✅ Exists. Implements `BalanceService` satisfying `IBalanceService`. Accepts pre-calculated day count.

3. `src/modules/balance/balance.controller.ts` — ✅ Exists. Fastify route handlers: getBalance (GET /balance/:employeeId/:leaveType), getBalances (GET /balance/:employeeId). Imports BalanceService.

4. `src/modules/balance/balance.routes.ts` — ✅ Exists. Registers Fastify routes for the balance controller. Exports a plugin function.

5. `src/modules/audit-log/audit-log.repository.ts` — ✅ Exists. Implements `PgAuditLogRepository` satisfying `IAuditLogRepository`. Uses pg Pool. Methods: findByEntity, create, findAll with optional filters (dynamic WHERE clause with indexed placeholders).

6. Tests — ✅ All exist and pass (70 tests across 6 suites).

Build: ✅ `tsc --noEmit` passes.
Tests: ✅ All 70 tests pass.

All constraints are satisfied:
- Uses `unknown` with type guards instead of `any` ✅
- Database calls go through repository pattern ✅
- No hardcoded secrets ✅
- No @gestalt/* dependencies ✅
- Balance entity has exactly the required fields ✅
- BalanceStatus enum imported from shared/types ✅
- Calendar days inclusive rule applied (service accepts pre-calculated count) ✅
- deductDays atomically updates remaining_days and used_days ✅
- Status transitions computed in SQL ✅
- AuditLog immutable after creation (no update/delete methods) ✅
- All imports go through proper module boundaries ✅
